name: Milkyway Cafe
address: 33 Brinkley St, Klein Brak River, 6503, South Africa
description_short: Friendly neighbourhood cafe in Glentana serving hearty breakfasts, light lunches and proper coffee.
description_long:
Tucked away in the quiet coastal village of Glentana, Milkyway Cafe is a welcoming spot where locals and visitors gather for good food and warm hospitality. The menu covers all the cafe classics done well — from full English breakfasts and fluffy pancakes to fresh salads, toasted sandwiches and homemade bakes that pair perfectly with their quality coffee.

The relaxed atmosphere makes it ideal for a leisurely breakfast before exploring the nearby beaches, or a quick lunch stop when travelling between George and Mossel Bay. With friendly service and generous portions at fair prices, this little cafe punches well above its weight. Whether you're after a strong cappuccino and a slice of cake or a proper sit-down meal, Milkyway delivers honest cafe fare without pretension.
